import struct

# Read the PoC
data = open('/workspace/poc.rgb', 'rb').read()
print(f'Total size: {len(data)} bytes')

# Parse header
magic = struct.unpack('>H', data[0:2])[0]
storage = data[2]
bpc = data[3]
dim = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
xsize = struct.unpack('>H', data[6:8])[0]
ysize = struct.unpack('>H', data[8:10])[0]
zsize = struct.unpack('>H', data[10:12])[0]
pixmin = struct.unpack('>I', data[12:16])[0]
pixmax = struct.unpack('>I', data[16:20])[0]
colormap = struct.unpack('>I', data[404:408])[0]

print(f'Header: magic=0x{magic:04X} storage={storage} bpc={bpc} dim={dim}')
print(f'        xsize={xsize} ysize={ysize} zsize={zsize}')
print(f'        pixmin={pixmin} pixmax={pixmax} colormap={colormap}')

numrows = ysize * zsize
print(f'numrows = {ysize} * {zsize} = {numrows}')

# Check start table entries
print(f'Start table entries (at offset 512):')
for i in range(numrows):
    off = 512 + i * 4
    if off + 4 <= len(data):
        val = struct.unpack('>I', data[off:off+4])[0]
        print(f'  _starttab[{i}] = {val} (offset {off})')
    else:
        print(f'  _starttab[{i}] = <UNINITIALIZED - past EOF>')

# Check length table entries
print(f'Length table entries (at offset {512 + numrows * 4}):')
for i in range(numrows):
    off = 512 + numrows * 4 + i * 4
    if off + 4 <= len(data):
        val = struct.unpack('>I', data[off:off+4])[0]
        print(f'  _lengthtab[{i}] = {val} (offset {off})')
    else:
        print(f'  _lengthtab[{i}] = <UNINITIALIZED - past EOF>')

# Verify: the stream should end before all starttab entries are read
# Stream reads from offset 512
# After reading 2 starttab entries (8 bytes), we're at offset 520
# Total file size is 520, so stream.atEnd() is true
print(f'\\nStream reads {min(numrows, (len(data) - 512) // 4)} starttab entries before EOF')
print(f'Remaining {numrows - min(numrows, (len(data) - 512) // 4)} starttab entries are uninitialized')
print(f'All {numrows} lengthtab entries are uninitialized')
print(f'\\nMSAN will report use-of-uninitialized-value at line 350 when reading _starttab[2] and _starttab[3]')
"
